summary: Official Heidelberg evidence establishes the Vermessungsamt/Liegenschaftskataster custodian and a current public queryable rendered Liegenschaftskarte WMS layer. Anonymous feature-info requests returned no parcel object with safe native identity and full geometry, so no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
